info.title: DisplayMagician v4 target REST API (P0 draft)
info.description: Design-only schemas for the target REST API. This file does not describe routes available in the current Gateway build. Docs/REST/openapi.yaml remains the implemented prototype contract. Only the routes with completed draft schemas are listed here.

servers.description: Trusted LAN Gateway from a verified pairing QR.

200.description: Public pairing identity. Does not authenticate a device.

get.summary: Read public API support, not device grants

post.summary: Submit one verified QR pairing session

202.description: Request accepted for local or authorized remote approval.

get.summary: List pending pairing requests for the paired user
Poll one candidate request using its temporary secret

200.description: Pending, rejected, or first approved poll. The approved variant delivers the bearer credential once.

put.summary: Approve a subset of requested grants, or reject

200.description: Decision recorded; no bearer credential is returned to the approver.

get.summary: Read the authenticated device and its current grants

200.description: The authenticated device. No devices-read grant is needed.

get.summary: List the paired user's active devices

200.description: User-scoped devices, without credentials or public keys.

delete.summary: Revoke one device, including the caller itself

204.description: Credential revoked before the response is sent. An accepted operation continues.

get.summary: List visible active and retained operations
Read the latest retained operation snapshot

200.description: Latest snapshot, possibly marked stale while UserAgent is unavailable.

304.description: Representation has not changed; no body.

202.description: Cancellation request accepted; operation completion remains asynchronous.

get.summary: List decisions for one visible operation

200.description: Decisions for the operation, including retained resolved decisions.
Answer recorded or the original idempotency result replayed.

get.summary: List the paired user's pending decisions

200.description: Only pending decisions visible to the paired user.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous event on this paired user's stream. A valid retained cursor replays only later events with no snapshot; an absent, unknown, or expired cursor starts with a fresh snapshot.

200.description: UTF-8 Server-Sent Events. A new or unresumable stream starts with an id-bearing snapshot; a valid retained Last-Event-ID replays later events with no snapshot. Replay and live subscription have no event gap. Every data field is JSON for the named event schema; comments are keep-alives.

schema.description: SSE frame stream; use x-sse-eventSchemas for typed data payloads.

pairingPoll.description: Phone-generated 256-bit polling secret for one pairing request only.

ProtocolHello.name: DisplayMagician-Protocol-Hello
ProtocolHello.description: Unpadded base64url of UTF-8 JSON for the shared ProtocolHello contract. Required on public requests too; it is not authentication.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: A fresh canonical lowercase UUID v4 per intended mutation; retained for 24 hours after acceptance.

DeviceId.name: deviceId
DeviceId.description: Opaque ID; clients must encode it as one path segment.

ProfileId.name: profileId
ProfileId.description: Opaque saved-resource ID encoded as one path segment.

ShortcutId.name: shortcutId
ShortcutId.description: Opaque shortcut ID encoded as one path segment.

IfNoneMatch.name: If-None-Match
IfNoneMatch.description: Compare the current representation ETag for this exact query.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque continuation token bound to user/device, route, filters, and a 10-minute stable collection snapshot. Clients must not inspect or modify it.

ProtocolWelcome.description: Unpadded base64url of UTF-8 JSON for the shared ProtocolWelcome contract. Present on every successful response.

RequestId.description: Server-generated request ID for this HTTP attempt.

DisplayProfilePageSuccess.description: Compact saved display profiles; artwork is optional.

ShortcutPageSuccess.description: Compact saved shortcuts; artwork is optional.

ShortcutDetailSuccess.description: One saved shortcut without executable paths or arguments.

AcceptedOperation.description: Operation accepted for asynchronous execution; not a terminal success.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 Problem Details. The status and errorCode identify the failure.

Secret256.description: Canonical unpadded base64url of exactly 32 cryptographically random bytes; validate decoded length and canonical re-encoding.

SpkiPin.description: Canonical padded RFC 4648 Base64 of SHA-256 over DER X.509 SubjectPublicKeyInfo; validate decoded length and canonical re-encoding.

HostId.description: Canonical unpadded base64url SHA-256 RFC 7638 JWK thumbprint of the P-256 host public key.

hostIdentityPublicKeyJwk.description: JSON-encoded public P-256 identity JWK; verify against the trusted QR payload.

PairingQrPayload.description: Design-only schema for JSON inside displaymagician://pair?payload=<unpad-base64url-utf8-json>. This object is generated by local WinForms, not a REST response.

gatewayUri.description: HTTPS origin only: scheme, host, and port; no path, query, fragment, or userinfo.

id.description: Opaque device ID bound to the credential.

isFinished.description: True when status is succeeded, failed, or cancelled; false while the operation is still in progress.

canCancel.description: True only while active, authoritative, and at a safe cancellation point. A later cancellation can still return 409 if eligibility changes. False for stale and terminal operations.

operations.description: Present only with status-read. Older retained operations are paged through /v1/operations.

pendingDecisions.description: Present only with decisions-read. More pending decisions are paged through /v1/decisions.

SavedResourceId.description: Opaque ID returned exactly as stored. Lookup is case-insensitive, matching the user's repository, and responses return the stored spelling. Stable across rename; recreated items receive a new ID.

PngArtwork.description: Optional PNG data, at most 256 KiB decoded. Included only when includeArtwork=true.

PairingPollResult.description: A single simple response object. awaiting-approval and rejected include expiresAt; approved includes deviceId, credential, and grantedCapabilities exactly once. No credential appears in other states.

PairingDecisionRequest.description: For approved, grantedCapabilities is required and must be a nonempty subset of requested capabilities. For rejected, grantedCapabilities must be absent.

instance.description: Request path without secrets or query credentials.
